zh: 权重 i 随位置递增，大的值应该放在后面。如果较大的值排在权重较小的位置，交换后总和会增加两个正差的乘积，所以最优排列按数值非降。
相同数值之间互换不改变总和，只影响字典序；要让字典序最小，就让同值元素的下标从小到大排列。
把下标按（数值，下标）升序排序，依次输出这些下标（从 1 开始编号）。
en: The weight i grows with the position, so larger values belong later. If a larger value sits at a smaller weight, swapping increases the sum by the product of two positive differences, so the optimal permutation has non-decreasing values.
Swapping equal values does not change the sum and only affects the lexicographic order; to make it smallest, list equal values in increasing index order.
Sort the indices by (value, index) in ascending order and print them, numbered from 1.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Order the indices by element value in ascending order; for equal values, order them by original index in ascending order.

## Proof of correctness

If a larger value is at a position with smaller weight, swapping them gains the product of two positive differences, so an optimal permutation has non-decreasing values. Equal values can be swapped freely without changing the sum, and ascending indices give the lexicographically smallest arrangement.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
